cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Closer on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to repair the relationship while redefining closeness around the boundaries that benefit you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Yes, let's reconnect. I'll come for dinner and leave at ten. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We need to discuss why you left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Of course. Put that before pudding so we finish on something nice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if I'm still upset at ten?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll book another dinner. I want us to keep seeing each other without either evening running over.

mechanism: A confidently plans reconnection, offering useful accommodations while keeping emotional discussion inside a self-protective evening cutoff.
confusable: Unlike agreeing to open-ended repair, A defines closeness as repeated bounded dinners; borrowed authority keeps B engaged by offering service and another meeting.
comparison: Fixed evening endpoint and recurring dinner differ from controlling the medium and timing of unresolved arguments on a weekend.
seedUse: Use D95-a dinner/ten/why left/pudding/another dinner and S02-a adapting the sequence while keeping a declared limit.
